specification: infrastructure: region launches, data-centre openings and construction starts, cable incidents, capacity benchmarks
compliance: enforcement orders, migrations, bars and liftings, filings, undertakings
operational; under construction; announced; reported consideration; enforced; lifted; negative; benchmark; undertaking; observed; in force
official: regulator, ministry, legislature, court documents; corporate press releases and official corporate blogs
established media: international wires; national dailies of record
trade and industry: specialist infrastructure trade press; industry-association estimates
enforcement events are coded only from T1 sources
material facts resting on a single non-official source are excluded
cable incidents are coded only where at least two national outlets reported actual service degradation
corporate capacity claims are always recorded with a status (operational / under construction / announced / reported consideration)
fit conditions are coded from the pre-outcome record; territorialisation outcomes are coded only from post-mandate events
